profile.headline: Software Engineer at Copley Controls Corporation
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the motion control industry. Skilled in C++, C#, Java, Python, Visual Basic, and Assembly programming languages. Proficient in EtherCAT, CANopen, Ethernet/IP, Modbus TCP/IP, TCP/IP, UDP, Serial Binary and ASCII communication protocols. Strong engineering professional with a Masters Degree in Computer Science from Syracuse University College of Engineering and Computer Science and a Bachelor of Science (BS) focused in Electrical Engineering from Trinity College-Hartford.
